user_questions: How do I know I'm getting genuine USD treatment?
How do I verify my treatment?
Will I receive proof it's genuine?
treatment_authentication.voice_response: Every genuine Ultimate Smile Design treatment follows the authorised process and is handcrafted through Advance Dental Export. Your Authentication Card provides case-related information that can be verified through the official website.
treatment_authentication.follow_up: Would you like me to explain what makes Ultimate Smile Design different?

user_questions: Can I choose the shape or colour?
smile_results.voice_response: The intention is for the smile to feel naturally aligned with your face rather than obviously treated. Like exceptionally well-made jewellery, the refinement should be visible without overwhelming the person wearing it.
smile_results.follow_up: Would you like to know how veneers help achieve that natural result?

website_navigation_preview.guidance: When inbound callers want to see their future smile:
website_navigation_preview.script: You can try our Virtual AI Smile Preview right on our homepage at ultimatesmiledesign.com. Simply upload a photo, and the AI will generate a digital simulation of your new smile.

website_navigation_find_dentist.guidance: When inbound callers want to find a doctor:
website_navigation_find_dentist.script: You can use the 'Find Dentist' tool on ultimatesmiledesign.com to explore all our authorized smile designers in your city.
